classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 43 explicitly defines equality by identical elements; evaluating the defining equations gives the three rosters.

content.prompt:
Which of the following sets are equal?
$$\begin{aligned}X&=\{x\in\mathbb R\text{ where }x^2=16\}\\Y&=\{x\in\mathbb R\text{ where }x+4=0\}\\Z&=\{4,-4\}\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked:
$(-4)^2=16$ and $4^2=16$, while $x+4=0$ gives $x=-4$.
$$\begin{align*}X&=\{-4,4\}\\Y&=\{-4\}\\Z&=\{4,-4\}\end{align*}$$
Thus $X=Z$, because order does not affect equality of sets. $Y$ does not contain 4.
